editorial:
If you grew up with Pokémon, this movie feels like a big, colorful adventure with real stakes. Ash, Pikachu, Dawn, and Brock get pulled into a time-travel mission when Arceus, the powerful creator Pokémon, decides humanity must pay for an old betrayal. The story mixes fantasy, action, and heartfelt friendship, so you get both big battles and emotional moments. It is easy to follow, even if you only know the basics, and the world feels bright and exciting.

The animation looks sharp, the legendary Pokémon battles are fun, and the time-travel twist keeps you guessing. Some scenes move fast, and younger viewers may need help with the timeline, but the heart stays strong. If you enjoy family adventures with monsters, teamwork, and a clear good-versus-bad message, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ash and his friends help return the Jewel of Life to Arceus, proving that people can keep their promises. Arceus stops its attack, forgives humanity, and saves Michina Town from being destroyed. In the end, the timeline changes, so the old betrayal no longer leads to disaster, and everyone gets a hopeful fresh start together at last.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Pokémon, family adventures, and time-travel stories.
